value.rationale: The originating paper classifies the origin's stable basin but leaves the global fate of other initial points unstated. Its complement is shown to split exactly into two absorbing superexponential escape basins; nonwandering and invariant-probability dynamics collapse to a single origin. This is a full natural dynamical classification of an entire sign/parity regime and quantifies both escape rays, not an arbitrary small parameter slice or a textbook deduction from the known basin theorem.
